claims.text: Interactions incl drugs that raise bleed risk, abx, antifungals, botanicals and CYP2C9/1A2/3A4 inhibitors or inducers;
claims.quote: Concomitant use of drugs that increase bleeding risk, antibiotics, antifungals, botanical (herbal) products, and inhibitors and inducers of CYP2C9, 1A2, or 3A4.

claims.text: check the INR more often when starting or stopping any drug.
claims.quote: Perform more frequent INR monitoring when starting or stopping other drugs, including botanicals, or when changing dosages of other drugs

claims.text: Bleed = most likely in the first mo;
claims.quote: Bleeding is more likely to occur within the first month.

claims.text: RF incl INR > 4.0, highly var INRs, prior GI bleed, HTN and renal impairment.
claims.quote: Risk factors for bleeding include high intensity of anticoagulation (INR >4.0), age greater than or equal to 65, history of highly variable INRs, history of gastrointestinal bleeding, hypertension, cerebrovascular disease, anemia, malignancy, trauma, renal impairment
When calciphylaxis is diagnosed in these patients, discontinue JANTOVEN and treat calciphylaxis as appropriate.

claims.text: don't use as initial therapy in HIT, where limb ischemia, necrosis and gangrene have occurred.
claims.quote: Do not use JANTOVEN as initial therapy in patients with heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) and with heparin-induced thrombocytopenia with thrombosis syndrome (HITTS).
